notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 36 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 147,456 B/token (144.0 KiB), counting the 36-layer, 4096-hidden text backbone only. All 36 layers are full attention (sliding_window null, use_sliding_window false, max_window_layers 36). The SigLIP vision tower, the Whisper-medium-style audio encoder (32 encoder layers, 1500 mel frames) and the MiniCPMTTS stack are single forward passes or separate small models and add no per-token decoder KV. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. HF card publishes Seed-TTS, MMAU, VoiceBench, LibriSpeech tables; all six rows match.
